features: [FULL HD 5MP LIVE VIEW DAY AND NIGHT]: Stream 5MP video 24 hours a day via the app — see faces, read number plates, and monitor all activity on your property in real-time.
[EASY REMOTE ACCESS]: Monitor live HD footage, play back recordings, and control the camera from anywhere on Android or iOS — no data restrictions on live view.

[COLOUR NIGHT VISION UP TO 20 METRES]: Maizic Smarthome's full-colour night vision identifies faces, clothing colours, and vehicle number plates clearly even in complete darkness — far superior to black-and-white IR-only cameras.

[AI MOTION DETECTION WITH INSTANT ALERTS]: Smart human-detection sends real-time push notifications to your phone the moment movement is detected — filtering false alarms from animals or trees, 24 hours a day.
[TWO-WAY AUDIO]: Built-in microphone and speaker let you hear and speak through the camera using the app — warn intruders, communicate with family, or answer visitors from anywhere in India.
[3MP FULL HD VIDEO CLARITY]: Capture sharp and detailed 3MP Full HD video for reliable indoor monitoring, helping you keep an eye on your home, office, kids, pets, and loved ones.
[360° PTZ PAN & TILT COVERAGE]: Remotely control the camera with smooth 360° pan and tilt movement to monitor every corner of your room with fewer blind spots.
[FULL COLOR NIGHT VISION]: Experience clear visibility in low-light conditions with advanced color night vision, providing enhanced monitoring during both day and night.
[SMART MOTION TRACKING & INSTANT ALERTS]: Automatically detects and tracks movement while sending real-time motion notifications to your smartphone, so you stay informed of important activity.
[TWO-WAY AUDIO COMMUNICATION]: Built-in microphone and speaker let you listen and talk in real time through the mobile app, making it easy to communicate with family members or visitors.
[REMOTE MOBILE VIEWING ANYTIME]: Access live view, playback, and camera controls from your smartphone using a compatible app, whether you're at home or away.
[MULTI-USER SHARING]: Securely share camera access with family members, allowing multiple users to monitor the same camera simultaneously.
